title: QA Lead (Copado Robotic testing)
description:
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
 **Amgen is seeking a QA Lead – Salesforce \& Copado Robotic Testing** 
 to lead quality engineering and testing capabilities for enterprise Salesforce platforms, including OneCRM and its integrated ecosystem. This role will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and compliant application releases through a combination of
 **manual, functional, integration, regression, and automated testing using Copado Robotic Testing (CRT)** 
 .
   

  

 The QA Lead will own the end\-to\-end testing strategy and execution, lead cross\-functional QA teams, and partner closely with business, product, engineering, architecture, and production support teams to ensure releases meet functional, technical, and quality expectations while supporting Amgen’s mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**QA \& Testing Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end QA activities for Salesforce applications and their integrated ecosystem, ensuring high\-quality releases with minimal production defects.
* Define and drive the overall test strategy, test planning, execution, defect management, and reporting across releases.
* Lead testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing phases.
* Ensure appropriate test coverage based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and integration specifications.
* Serve as the primary QA point of contact for product, business, engineering, and technology stakeholders.


**Manual \& Functional Testing**
* Lead comprehensive manual testing of Salesforce applications, including business processes, workflows, validations, security, profiles, permission sets, and user experience.
* Design, review, and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Ensure adequate coverage of positive, negative, boundary, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Validate complex Salesforce business processes spanning multiple objects, personas, applications, and integrations.
* Drive exploratory and risk\-based testing for business\-critical capabilities.


**Copado Robotic Testing \& Test Automation**
* Lead adoption and implementation of Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Design and maintain reusable, scalable, and maintainable automated test suites using Copado Robotic Testing.
* Identify appropriate manual regression scenarios for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, and ROI.
* Establish and continuously improve the automated regression test suite to increase coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release pipelines wherever applicable.
* Monitor automation execution results, investigate failures, and ensure timely maintenance of automated test scripts.
* Define standards and best practices for Copado Robotic Testing development, execution, and maintenance.


**Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**
* Lead end\-to\-end testing across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms, including MuleSoft APIs, Databricks, and other upstream/downstream applications.
* Validate API integrations, data transformations, interface processing, error handling, and data reconciliation.
* Coordinate testing dependencies across multiple application and technology teams.
* Ensure critical business journeys are validated across the complete application and integration landscape.


**Defect Management \& Quality Governance**
* Establish and enforce standardized defect management, triage, prioritization, and closure processes.
* Lead defect triage sessions with business, development, and product teams.
* Ensure defects are appropriately categorized based on severity, priority, business impact, and release risk.
* Track defect trends, leakage, reopen rates, and recurring quality issues.
* Drive root cause analysis for escaped production defects and implement preventive actions.
* Establish appropriate quality gates and release\-readiness criteria before production deployment.


**Test Planning \& Release Management**
* Develop comprehensive test plans and testing schedules aligned with sprint and release timelines.
* Estimate QA effort and determine appropriate testing capacity based on release scope and complexity.
* Coordinate QA activities across Agile sprints, major releases, hotfixes, patches, and production maintenance releases.
* Assess testing risks and proactively communicate potential impacts to release timelines.
* Provide clear QA sign\-off and release\-readiness recommendations based on test results, open defects, and residual risks.
* Support post\-production validation and hypercare testing following major releases.


**Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive the transition from traditional testing toward a quality engineering and automation\-first approach.
* Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing through automation.
* Improve test efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, standardized processes, and optimized test data management.
* Establish QA standards, templates, metrics, and best practices across the delivery organization.
* Leverage defect and production incident trends to continuously strengthen regression coverage.
* Promote shift\-left testing, enabling early QA involvement during requirements, refinement, and solution\-design activities.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Scrum Masters, and Production Support teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Participate in requirements and user\-story refinement to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and complete.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to coordinate integration and end\-to\-end testing.
* Act as the bridge between business and technology teams for quality\-related discussions.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and release readiness to leadership and key stakeholders.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor onshore/offshore QA and test automation teams.
* Drive appropriate allocation of QA resources based on release priorities and workload.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to manual and automation testers.
* Establish standards for test documentation, traceability, automation, and defect management.
* Drive knowledge sharing, cross\-skilling, and capability development within the QA team.
* Mentor team members on Salesforce testing, Copado Robotic Testing, quality engineering, and testing best practices.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 9–13 years of overall experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or Quality Engineering.
* Significant experience leading QA activities for large\-scale enterprise applications and complex releases.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong experience in Salesforce functional and manual testing.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, preferably including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Health Cloud.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated regression test suites.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations, MuleSoft APIs, REST/SOAP services, and data interfaces.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks is preferred.
* Experience with end\-to\-end, integration, regression, API, and data validation testing.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and CI/CD practices.
* Familiarity with Copado, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise delivery and ticketing platforms.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
* Strong understanding of test automation strategy, quality gates, and release\-readiness criteria.
* Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences.
* Understanding of GxP, compliance, data privacy, and validation requirements is preferred.
* Proven experience managing distributed onshore/offshore QA teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and customer experience.
* Ability to prioritize multiple testing activities and deliver effectively under tight release timelines.
* Strong ownership and accountability for application quality.
* Team\-oriented with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
* Ability and willingness to mentor QA engineers and promote testing and automation best practices.
* Ability to challenge requirements and solutions constructively from a quality and end\-user perspective.
* Adaptable to changing business priorities, project requirements, and evolving technology.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

 Together, we live the Amgen values as we continue advancing science to serve patients.

title: Senior or Staff ATE Test Engineer
description:
We are looking for experienced and motivated ATE Test Engineers with hands\-on expertise in the Advantest V93000 ATE platform (SMT8\). In this key role, you will be responsible for developing, debugging, and deploying high\-quality test solutions for next\-generation semiconductor devices. This is an exciting opportunity to join our engineering team and contribute to the advancement of test programs for cutting\-edge ICs. The position is well\-suited for software engineers with a strong electronics background or semiconductor test engineers experienced in ATE Test program development.
 




  






 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Hyderabad/Remote (Hybrid)
 




  






 𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:
 





 • Develop and maintain automated test programs on ATE platforms such as Advantest V93000, using C\+\+ / Java in a Linux\-based environment
 





 • Design, debug, and optimize functional, parametric, and performance tests across all test phases engineering, characterization, and production
 





 • Convert simulation or digital test patterns into tester\-compatible formats, ensuring correct timing and execution
 





 • Create test flows for both wafer\-level and final testing to achieve high test coverage, efficiency, and repeatability
 





 • Review device specifications and datasheets to design effective and comprehensive test strategies
 





 • Collaborate closely with design, DFT, and product engineering teams to align test plans with overall product goals
 





 • Analyze test data to identify trends, optimize yield, and support silicon bring\-up and validation
 





 • Improve test efficiency and throughput while ensuring data accuracy and robustness
 





 • Support the design and validation of test hardware such as load boards and probe cards
 




  






 𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:
 



* Bachelors or Masters degree in Electronics, Microelectronics, or Computer Science
* 3–9 years of experience in ATE test program development, preferably with Advantest V93000 and SMT7/SMT8
* Proficiency in C\+\+ and scripting languages like Python or Ruby
* Comfortable working in Linux environments, with experience in Git and modern IDEs (e.g., Eclipse)
* Solid understanding of semiconductor testing and digital test methodologies
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Customer\-focused, with the ability to deliver results under pressure










 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿
 





 • A dynamic, collaborative work environment with a diverse and international team
 





 • Flexible working hours and a hybrid model
 





 • A flat and transparent organizational structure that encourages initiative and open communication
 





 • Potential onsite opportunities for international collaboration and project engagement

title: Services Senior Staff Consultant
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:** 
 Senior MES Software Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 \[Bangalore / Hyderabad]
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**The job**
 We are seeking a skilled and experienced MES Software Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in C\#, MS SQL Server, JavaScript, and RESTful Web APIs, along with hands\-on experience or understanding of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and implement scalable MES solutions supporting manufacturing processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain applications using C\#, .NET Framework/Core, and Web APIs
* Create and optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and database schemas
* Implement responsive and interactive front\-end components using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
* Integrate with external systems (e.g., SAP, PLCs, SCADA) as part of MES architecture
* Participate in requirements gathering, system design, and code reviews
* Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in manufacturing environments
* Collaborate with process engineers and production teams to understand MES requirements
* Ensure best practices in coding, security, and system performance
* Maintain detailed technical documentation


**Essential Requirements**
* Knowledge of ISA\-95, 21 CFR Part 11, or GMP compliance
* Experience with reporting tools, dashboards, or historian systems
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies


**Desired Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in C\#, .NET, Web API development \& MES
* Proficient in MS SQL Server, including T\-SQL, stored procedures, and performance tuning
* Strong experience in JavaScript and front\-end development
* Experience or exposure to MES systems (e.g., Aveva/Wonderware, Rockwell FT, Siemens Opcenter, etc.), having AVEVA MES technical stack experience is a plus.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes, production workflows, and shop floor integration
* Familiarity with OPC, PLC communication, and industrial data protocols is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills


**Services at AVEVA**
 Our dynamic global team of 700\+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting\-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.
   

  

 Find out more:
 
 https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
   

  


**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process
   

  

**About AVEVA**
 AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
   

  

 AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
   

  

 AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Deputy Director - AI Solution and Platforms
description:
**Overview**
 The AI Solution Engineer is a delivery focused engineer who designs, builds, and operates production agentic AI applications, along with the platform services those applications run on. Working within the technical direction set by AI Solutions and Platforms leadership, the AI Solution Engineer translates solution architecture into production grade agents, retrieval pipelines, tool and system integrations, evaluation harnesses, and the guardrails and observability that keep those systems reliable once live.
   

  

 The AI Solution Engineer is a hands on practitioner who codes, integrates, tests, and iterates, owning feature level delivery across one or more solution or platform tracks while building a working understanding of the wider AI platform. The role works daily with modern AI engineering tooling, including agentic frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Codex. This is a technical builder first, with a growing architect mindset
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
* Solution Architecture and Delivery: Architect, build and deploy production agentic AI applications for R\&D, taking them from problem definition and prototype through to production use by scientists and engineers.
* Hands On Engineering: Write production Python and own the difficult parts, including retrieval quality, tool and function design, multi agent orchestration, context management, structured outputs, latency and unit cost. Set the technical bar through design and code review.
* Agentic Framework Selection: Build with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP and agent to agent patterns. Select the appropriate model across Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI and Google model families, and recognise when a deterministic or classical machine learning approach is the correct answer.
* Evaluation and Quality: Establish evaluation as a delivery gate, covering golden datasets built with R\&D subject matter experts, automated evaluations in CI, regression and grounded Ness testing, red teaming, and human review in the loop. Take solutions from prototype into production and remain accountable for them once live.
* Platform Ownership: Own the shared AI platform for R\&D, including retrieval and vector infrastructure, agent runtime, prompt and model registry, MCP server and connector layer, guardrails, tracing and observability, cost attribution and rate management. Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so that downstream teams ship in weeks rather than quarters.
* MLOps and LLMOps: Embed CI/CD for models, prompts and agents, infrastructure as code, environment promotion, versioning, monitoring, incident response, model deprecation and migration.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI solutions with the R\&D and enterprise estate, including PLM, LIMS, specification and document management systems, SAP, the Azure data platform and the enterprise Lakehouse.
* Security and Governance: Own security, privacy and governance for these systems in partnership with Cyber, Legal, Privacy and Responsible AI, covering access control, secrets management, handling of confidential formulation and specification data, and auditability. Contribute to AI governance standards for R\&D.
* People Leadership: Lead, coach and grow a team of AI and platform engineers. Develop technical depth in the team and build AI literacy across the wider R\&D community.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with R\&D scientists, category and platform leaders to convert ambiguous scientific problems into scoped, valuable products, and to decline those that will not work. Manage delivery partners and vendors. Communicate credibly with a food scientist and a cloud architect in the same conversation, and with senior leadership on portfolio, risk and value.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field. Masters preferred.
* 10 to 14 years in software, data or machine learning engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years building and running LLM and generative AI solutions in production.
* 2 or more years leading engineers, formally or as a senior technical lead, with evidence of having developed people.
* Strong hands\-on Python. Code quality will be assessed during the interview process.
* Deep practical experience with agentic AI, covering tool calling, planning, memory, multi agent and agent to agent patterns, retrieval augmented generation, structured output, guardrails and evaluation.
* Production experience with LangChain and LangGraph, or an equivalent framework such as LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Pydantic AI or custom orchestration, with a clear view of the tradeoffs.
* Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex or Cursor, including agent configuration and custom tooling rather than inline completion alone.
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals, including context windows, embeddings, tokenization, fine tuning versus adapters versus prompting, and failure modes such as hallucination and prompt injection.
* Cloud and platform engineering experience. Azure preferred, covering Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, AKS and Functions, or the equivalent on AWS or GCP. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or Bicep, CI/CD and API design.
* Data foundations, including SQL, Spark or Databricks, vector stores, and real experience working with messy unstructured technical documents.
* Prior delivery of technology for an R\&D, scientific or laboratory function in CPG, food and beverage, pharma, chemicals, flavors and fragrances, agriculture or materials science.
* Working familiarity with scientific and product data, including formulations and recipes, technical specifications, bills of materials, ingredient masters, sensory panel data, nutrition and claims data, and stability datasets.
* Experience with R\&D systems of record such as PLM, LIMS or ELN, and with specification and technical document management.
* Track record of taking agentic systems past pilot into sustained production use, with adoption and reliability data to evidence it.
* Experience building MCP servers and custom tool layers over enterprise APIs and internal systems.
* Retrieval engineering depth beyond baseline RAG, including hybrid and semantic search, reranking, chunking strategy for technical documents, and table and figure extraction.
* Databricks at production scale, including Unity Catalog, Delta and Lakehouse patterns.
* LLM cost engineering, including token accounting, caching, batching, routing across model tiers and chargeback to business units.
* Experience building internal developer platforms or shared services consumed by other engineering teams.
* Exposure to Responsible AI frameworks, AI model risk management, or EU AI Act readiness and comparable emerging regulation.
* Experience handling commercially sensitive or trade secret data, including how intellectual property is protected when third party models sit in the processing path.
* Experience in a global capability center delivering for global stakeholders across time zones, where the hub owned outcomes rather than executed tickets.
* Having hired, levelled and grown AI or platform engineers in the Indian market.
* A postgraduate qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or Data Science, or in a scientific discipline relevant to food, chemistry, materials or nutrition. Candidates who moved from science into engineering are of particular interest.
* Recognized AI engineering credentials, for example Anthropic's Claude Certified Developer Foundations or Claude Certified Architect exams, GitHub Copilot certification, or Microsoft, AWS or Google AI engineering certifications. Equivalent demonstrated experience is weighted equally.
* Open\-source contributions to agent or LLM tooling, conference talks, published papers or technical writing.

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Data Infrastructure \& Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate \& business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data \& platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests.
   

  

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SME, drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully\-designed solutions. Additionally, train/mentor the Test Automation team and help with creating dashboards for the reporting purposes.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role** 
 :
 **GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety \& Reliability)**
**Position Details**
 As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG\-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit\-for\-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no\-go decisions.
   

  

 You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk \& compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional \+ non\-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
   

  

 This is a core full\-time role that requires a hands\-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q\&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi\-step workflows.
* Translate business use\-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red\-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:
+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias \& fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:
+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding \& faithfulness (RAG\-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool\-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM\-as\-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:
+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):
+ Prompt injection (direct \+ indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial\-of\-service / denial\-of\-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre\-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:
+ tool misuse / over\-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least\-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high\-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision\-ready, including:
+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk\-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no\-go.


**Key Requirements/Skills \& Qualification:**
* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7\+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:
+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands\-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi\-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure\-by\-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse\-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical \+ non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast\-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain\-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands\-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).


**Additional skills requirements:**
* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self\-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self\-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 7200 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead Testing Services Consultant
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like
   

  

**what we’re saying, keep reading!**
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 The Lead Testing Services Consultant at SimCorp, provides leadership in the planning, execution, and optimization of testing services to ensure the delivery of high\-quality solutions. With typically 7\+ years of experience in testing or quality assurance, this role works independently to manage complex testing projects, drive process improvements, and mentor junior team members. The Lead Consultant collaborates with cross\-functional teams, ensures that testing activities meet organizational goals, and contributes to the overall success of service delivery
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Lead the design and execution of comprehensive test plans, ensuring high standards of quality and performance for SimCorp solutions
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define testing requirements, align on project goals, and ensure full test coverage
* Analyze and resolve complex testing issues, implementing effective solutions in a timely manner
* Optimize testing processes and adopt best practices to improve efficiency and reduce the time to delivery
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, enhancing skill development and promoting high\-quality testing standards
* Monitor and analyze testing metrics to assess performance and identify areas for continuous improvement
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation for test plans, cases, and results, ensuring thorough records of testing efforts
* Provide advanced insights on testing strategies, tools, and technologies to ensure the most effective solutions are being used


**WHAT WE VALUE:**
* Managing testing projects to ensure solutions meet quality and performance standards
* Collaborating with development, QA, and operations teams to integrate testing into the overall service delivery process
* Implementing initiatives to introduce automated testing tools and frameworks to enhance testing efficiency
* Conducting root cause analyses for recurring testing issues and ensuring long\-term solutions are in place
* Engaging with clients and stakeholders to communicate testing progress, results, and potential risks
* Facilitating training sessions and knowledge sharing to promote best practices in testing within the team
* Monitoring trends and advancements in testing technologies to ensure the adoption of up\-to\-date tools
* Managing escalations and ensuring timely resolution of complex testing challenges


**Benefits**
 Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work\-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
   

  

 Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
   

  

**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually
 **. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** 
 At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 For any questions you are welcome to contact
 **Swati Pal (Swati.pal@simcorp.com)** 
 , Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**WHO WE ARE?**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

title: Sr. SQE Performance Testing
description:
**Join the team as our new Senior Software Quality Engineer \- Performance Testing**
**Hyderabad, India \| Software Quality CoE**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior SQE \- Performance Testing to lead and own the end\-to\-end performance engineering lifecycle. The ideal candidate will contribute to defining the performance testing strategy, execute large\-scale load tests, and deliver actionable insights through robust reporting and analytics. This role will be part of the Software Quality CoE, and it demands strong technical expertise, critical thinking, and the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
   

  

 Additionally, this role requires leveraging modern AI/LLM tools to enhance productivity in automation, performance scripting, test design, and result analysis.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Performance Testing Strategy \& Ownership**
* Drive the overall performance testing strategy aligned with business and product goals.
* Own the end\-to\-end performance testing lifecycle, including planning, scripting, execution, monitoring, and reporting.


**Test Design \& Execution**
* Design and implement scalable load, stress, endurance, and spike test scenarios.
* Develop and maintain performance test frameworks and reusable assets.
* Execute tests to validate system scalability, reliability, and stability under load.


**Analysis \& Reporting**
* Analyze performance bottlenecks across application, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Deliver detailed performance reports, dashboards, and analytics with actionable recommendations.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Integration**
* Collaborate with development, DevOps, and architecture teams to resolve performance issues.
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous performance validation.
* Drive performance optimization initiatives and ensure SLAs/SLOs are met.


**What It Takes**
**Technical**
* 5 to 8 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Engineering.
* Strong expertise in any of the performance testing tools (code as a test) such as Gatling, K6, Locust, or similar.
* Solid understanding of performance testing methodologies, workload modeling, and capacity planning.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring \& observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar).
* Strong exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, etc.).
* Experience analyzing system metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, network, database performance).
* Proficiency in any scripting/programming language (Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized systems (Docker, Kubernetes).


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present performance insights to stakeholders.
* Ability to take ownership and make data\-driven decisions in high\-pressure scenarios.
* A team player who can challenge constructively and drive quality excellence.


**Mindset**
* A strong quality mindset with attention to detail and deep curiosity to identify system limits.
* Hands\-on, proactive, and continuously learning.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) or Digital Manufacturing domains.
* Experience in API performance testing and microservices architecture.
* Knowledge of shift\-left performance testing and performance engineering practices.

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.

description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**Role:**
 As a Senior Quality Engineer \- you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across StarRez communication, Marketplace, System Administration and Maintenance systems. You will be an expert within our product engineering organization, deeply understanding user and product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support StarRez personas. This role will balance hands\-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers.
   

  

 This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end\-to\-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process.
   

  

 Your role is not to manage a team, but to be a quality champion who partners directly with developers, product managers, designers, support, implementation, and customer\-facing teams. You will help teams anticipate risk, clarify expected behaviour, validate business logic, protect the customer experience, and build more robust, scalable, and reliable conference and event products. At the core of this role is a strong focus on the customer experience; success means our platform behaves predictably, is easy to use, and enables our resident communities to thrive.
   

  

**What You Will Own:**
* Own and drive end\-to\-end quality for the StarRez Foundations product team.
* Champion StarRez's quality standards by establishing, maintaining, and advocating for quality gates and rapid feedback loops throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute testing, validation and risk mitigation strategies for feature related initiatives.
* Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non\-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real customer operations and the intended product experience.
* Champion shift\-left quality culture by mentoring developers, product managers, and design partners on testing principles, behavioural specifications, clear acceptance criteria, early validation, fast feedback loops, and production\-quality observability.
* Work effectively with ambiguity, proactively designing quality solutions based on evidence when clear requirements, behaviour definitions, customer workflow expectations, or quality baselines do not yet exist.
* Champion test automation best practices, create clear testing standards, and coach engineers to take shared ownership of building and maintaining automated tests.
* Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes.
* Own production defect triage for your product domain, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Support to assess impact, prioritise fixes, identify root causes, and drive preventative quality improvements.


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed systems environments
* SQL. Required for test data setup, backend validation, data integrity checks across integrations, and root cause analysis.
* Tech stack context (.NET/C\#, SQL Server, Azure).
* API testing tooling (Postman, REST Assured, or similar).
* Cloud platform exposure (Azure/AWS).
* Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence\-based approaches.
* Hands\-on experience working with web\-based products, including front\-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Practical experience integrating automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub, Build\-kite, or similar platforms.
* Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection, environment readiness checks.
* Genuine curiosity and passion for understanding product architecture, user experience flows, customer workflows, analytics use cases, and the business impact of engineering and data decisions.
* Experience utilising AI in modern software development.


**Reasons to join our team:**
* Opportunity to be a part of a well\-established, high\-performance company that has been in business for over 30\+ years
* Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
* A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
* Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.
* Z\-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high\-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.


 Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!
   

  

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Data Infrastructure \& Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate \& business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data \& platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests.
   

  

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully\-designed solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Developing testing automation that provides timely, useful, and actionable independent insights


 on the operational health of Bank of America’s processes.
   

  

* Work closely with process owners in the Front\-Line Units and Control Functions (FLUs/CFs) to obtain an understanding of their processes, including underlying data, flows, and controls, and to identify risks to successful execution, so that appropriate testing and monitoring can be developed.
* The processes to be assessed, span across multiple Products, Regulations and Enterprise Processes. The outputs of the methodologies will be used to drive process improvements and timely detection and reporting of errors.
* The role requires being able to document and verbally explain the intuition and details behind the methodologies in a manner that is clear, concise, and consumable for a broad set of audiences that include key stakeholders across the Bank, as well as auditors and regulators.
* The Test Tools and Automation developer will then convert the test requirements into automated tests via Python and SQL.
* Enabling automatic test document generation from code
* Use programming skills and knowledge of software development lifecycle principles
* Design and develop and implement models and tests
* Produce clear, concise and repeatable technical documentation for models and/or tests
* Responsible for creating and revising code for data retrieval/manipulation when needed
* Responsible for securing testing data that meets the needs / supports given test design
* Independently gather test scripting and data requirements and work with data partners to ensure appropriate test design and sampling requirements are incorporated into the Test Plans
* Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modelling and testing business processes and requirements
* Perform debugging and code reviews to ensure quality of code.

Sitting within the People Tech team, you will act as the core quality coordinator responsible for ensuring complex, high\-sensitivity platform rollouts execute flawlessly without disrupting core HR workflows.
   

  

 Because People Tech changes are often bundled into broader People Team projects that impact employee experience, rollouts cannot always happen incrementally or iteratively. In this role, you will define end\-to\-end testing strategy, establish test script frameworks, and govern entry/exit criteria across project phases. You are not a process owner nor responsible for executing all test scripts yourself; instead, you will enable, organize, and guide People Team project resources who perform the validation across our People Tech stack (tools such as Workday, SmartRecruiters and Absorb).

* Phase Governance: Define, monitor, and enforce strict entry and exit criteria for major project testing phases prior to production deployment.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Coordinate testing schedules, resource alignment, and execution progress with People Team business process owners.
* Defect Management \& Triage: Lead defect tracking in Jira, facilitate triage sessions between People Team testers and People Tech engineers, and ensure root causes are addressed.
* Mentorship \& Quality Standards: Coach L1/L2 technicians on testing practices and maintain comprehensive test repositories and runbooks in Confluence.


**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For (Must\-Have)**
* Test Coordination Expertise: Proven background in QA coordination or technical test leading, specifically defining test scope, entry/exit gates, and script frameworks for large enterprise projects.
* People Platform Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of HRIS/ATS application workflows and sensitive HR business processes (specifically Workday, SmartRecruiters, Absorb, or Visier).
* Leadership Scope: Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional IT/People initiatives, manage project quality risks, and coach junior team members.
* Orchestration Skills: Experience guiding non\-technical stakeholders through structured testing execution while managing defect lifecycles.
* Tooling Proficiency: Deep hands\-on experience managing testing workflows via Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence.


**Nice to Have**
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks, API testing, or workflow automation tools (e.g. Workato).

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI\-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.

title: Engineer II, Software (RPA)
description:
**The Opportunity** 




 Ensemble Health Partners is one of the fastest\-growing revenue cycle management companies in healthcare. Our Automation \& AI Platform team is building the next generation of intelligent automation: moving beyond traditional rule\-based bots into agentic, AI\-driven automation and Computer Use Agents (CUA) that can see, reason about, and operate real applications the way a person does. We are looking for an Engineer II who lives and breathes Python and wants to build production automation at the intersection of RPA and applied AI. You will design and ship automations across web, Citrix, and document\-heavy workflows, then push them further with LLMs, OCR, and agentic techniques so they handle the messy, unstructured cases that classic RPA cannot. We care about how you reason about brittle real\-world systems, write clean Python, and learn quickly. Our stack spans Python, Playwright, Azure, Docker, and a fast\-growing agentic / CUA layer built on Azure OpenAI and open\-source LLMs. Strong engineers pick up the parts they haven't seen fast.
 



**Role \& responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test, and maintain production automations in Python across web, Citrix, and API\-driven workflows.
* Automate applications end to end: web automation (Playwright or Selenium), Citrix and virtual\-desktop automation, and OCR or document\-based automation.
* Build agentic and Computer Use Agent (CUA) automations that combine LLMs with UI control to handle tasks that rule\-based bots cannot.
* Apply document processing and intelligent data extraction, blending OCR with LLMs to turn unstructured inputs into structured, usable data.
* Integrate REST and SOAP APIs (auth, pagination, retries, error handling), preferring API\-driven steps over fragile UI wherever an API exists.
* Handle unattended\-execution concerns: secure secret handling, MFA such as TOTP, scheduling, structured logging, and graceful recovery.
* Package automations as Docker containers, run them on Azure, and ship through Azure DevOps Git with PR review and CI/CD pipelines.
* Write and optimize advanced SQL against SQL Server for data\-driven automations and reporting.
* Contribute to our shared automation platform, building reusable workers, connectors, and workflow components.
* Instrument what you build with structured logging, metrics, and Application Insights, and help triage and resolve production issues.



  





 What Were Looking For
 **Minimum 4 years of professional experience building and running production automations or software, with Python at the center of your work.** 




 Must\-Have Skills
 


* Python (required): strong core Python (data structures, OOP, exception handling), clean modular code, virtual environments and dependency management (pip / poetry / uv), HTTP and API work (requests / httpx), parsing JSON, CSV, and Excel data, logging, and writing tests.
* Hands\-on RPA delivery: production automations built in Python. Prior Power Automate / Power Automate Desktop experience is valued, and experience with any other RPA tool (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) is welcome, but Python is mandatory.
* Web, Citrix, and OCR automation: Playwright or Selenium for web, image / vision techniques for Citrix and virtual desktops, and OCR for documents.
* REST API integration: consuming third\-party APIs with auth flows, pagination, retries, and error handling.
* Advanced SQL: SQL Server / T\-SQL, complex joins, window functions, stored procedures, and query tuning.
* Azure fundamentals, hands\-on with: Service Bus, Key Vault, Function Apps, Application Insights, Automation Runbooks, and Azure AI Foundry.
* Docker: containerizing automations and running them reliably.
* Git and CI/CD: Azure DevOps pipelines, PR workflow, and branching.
* Unattended\-run fundamentals: secrets, MFA / TOTP, scheduling, and logging.



  





 Preferred / Stand\-Out
 


* Agentic automation and Computer Use Agent (CUA) experience: combining LLMs with UI control to build adaptive automations.
* AI / LLM engineering: Azure OpenAI, prompt design, and handling non\-deterministic output.
* Open\-source LLM experience: self\-hosting or serving models (for example vLLM) and integrating them into automation.
* Document processing at scale: intelligent extraction from PDFs and scanned documents using OCR and LLMs.
* FastAPI \+ Pydantic: building small services and APIs that sit behind automations.
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool / adapter abstractions.
* Healthcare / regulated\-data domain: familiarity with HIPAA constraints or Epic / FHIR integration.



  





**Why Choose Ensemble India?** 




 People First, Last \+ Always
 



 We believe in putting people at the heart of everything. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth and innovation—where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured.
 



  





**A Place to Thrive** 




 Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.
 



  





**Comprehensive Total Rewards** 




 We support the physical, emotional and financial well\-being of you and your family. Our Total Rewards package include:
 



 • Healthcare coverage for associates and their immediate families including parents
 



 • Paid time off plans
 



 • Retirement benefits
 



 • Recognition and wellness programs
 



 • Market competitive pay rates
 



  





**Inclusive Culture** 




 Our organization is deeply committed to fostering a positive environment and culture where we celebrate and reward merit and contribution and where every associate feels valued, included, and empowered to succeed.
 



  





**Purpose\-Driven Impact** 




 We proudly partner with local communities through philanthropic initiatives—from school supply drives to health awareness campaigns—because giving back is part of who we are.

 . It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable
 **federal, state, or local laws.**

title: Alpha Implementation Test Associate - Emerging Lead
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are seeking a results‑driven professional with deep expertise in testing within large‑scale, client‑facing transformation programs. Within
 **GCI’s Global Testing Practice** 
 , the focus is on strategy, planning, execution, and management of end‑to‑end platform testing across implementation programs. These programs span front, middle, and back office operations and involve complex data flows across State Street, Charles River Development, clients, and industry partners.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, familiarity with AI concepts, and an interest in leveraging AI‑driven approaches to enhance test coverage, efficiency, and quality.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 GCI plays a critical role in driving seamless integration across front, middle, and back‑office workflows within State Street’s interoperable platform ecosystem. Rigorous end‑to‑end testing of applications, data, and workflows is essential to accelerating implementation timelines, ensuring reliability, and delivering a consistent, high‑quality client experience.
   

  

 This role directly supports our mission by strengthening test strategy, enhancing operational readiness, and enabling AI‑supported testing practices that improve speed, accuracy, and scalability across transformation programs.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Represent State Street GCI in client engagements, setting expectations and guiding clients throughout the end‑to‑end testing journey.
* Manage resource allocation for the testing team.
* Lead strategic delivery initiatives and contribute to the implementation model within GCI.
* Oversee a global team of functional and automation testers, ensuring high\-quality delivery across regions.
* Drive the adoption of best practices, testing standards, and process excellence across the organization.
* Script, Run and troubleshoot Robotic test automation
* Support AI understanding and champion the adoption of AI‑driven testing methodologies.
* Demonstrate excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
* Exemplify a delivery\-focused, team\-driven mindset and act as a role model for peers and colleagues.
* Be a back\-up to Test lead and assist in producing test metrics and status reporting to the management on timely basis
* Coordination with US / UK and third\-party vendors or SSC Clients
* Flexibility to work in APAC/UK hrs (when required).


**What We Value**
 The successful candidate must have strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, along with a deep understanding of
 **global portfolio management and financial servicing** 
 , including portfolio construction, trading, compliance, and risk across major asset classes.
   

  

**Skills That Will Help You Succeed In This Role**
* 4 \-9 years of experience in functional testing with a solid understanding of Capital Markets
* 3\+ years leading project teams across internal and external stakeholder groups.
* Hands\-on experience with Investment Banking applications across Front Office (CRD), Middle Office, and Back Office, spanning multiple asset classes.
* Strong capability in designing Test Strategy and Test Approach aligned with client service models.
* Ability to plan and execute activities based on project milestones.
* Experience producing test metrics and delivering timely status reporting to management.
* Proven ability to manage cross\-functional stakeholders and deliver programs effectively.
* Proficiency with Test Management Tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SQL, and PowerPoint.
* Work closely with Business (Test case reviews/ops readiness) and IT teams (deployments/fixes)
* Defect Management – Articulation of defects in detailed manner, assigning defects to technical teams, capturing target fix dates and resolution comments from IT
* Good understanding of AI concepts and familiarity with AI‑driven testing approaches, including identifying opportunities for AI adoption within testing processes.
* Experience with Test Automation Management Tools such as UiPath.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Accounting, Finance, Management or Information System Management.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
